purpose: Discriminate tactical learnability from long-horizon sparse-target failure; not a claim of full-Act2 improvement
task: Third distinct combat floor in Act2 from natural Neow prefix; multiple event fights on one floor count as one floor; no resources altered
initialization: Explicit V5-to-V6 weights; actor and GRU preserved; final value linear zero; new Adam
source_selection: One predeclared third-combat root per origin; stop before any target action; record all nonarrivals
reward: Current battle win +1, death/player escape/protection failure -1, intermediate 0; gamma 1; no production reward edit; escape remains legal and is separately reported
optimization: Existing A PPO parameters; full network; domain normalization; no hyperparameter search
primary: Fixed-budget endpoint greedy win rate versus frozen parent; same source roots and initial RNG; own current-weight history per policy
selection: Development only every 32 updates; never replace endpoint with a peak

power_alternative.warning: Not designed to reliably certify a true effect exactly on the 10pp observed threshold

secondary: Value versus complete battle returns and fit-mean constant
baseline_guard: If fresh development parent greedy rate is outside 20%-80%, block formal training without selecting individual roots
stop: Signal or wall budget: save completed update and stop

failure_decisions.fit_only_gain: Generalization not established: expand fresh fit origins/representation diagnosis before more full-Act2 budget
failure_decisions.no_fit_gain: Check logprob reproduction, KL/clip, exact short returns and action representation before choosing algorithm alternative
failure_decisions.confirmation_pass: No automatic promotion; independently replicate with a fresh confirmation bank, then evaluate full Act2 suffix resource costs
failure_decisions.confirmation_fail: Close this trial; no automatic extension or checkpoint reselection

server_gate: One allocation: real-parent formal-shape GPU smoke and exact-action safe replay must pass before long training
long_term: Natural-start A20 Ironclad joint Act1+Act2 success; count all failures/protection events; 70%-80% is an unproven research aspiration
